title: v4.1 configure and install OpenClaw Gateway
backup: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; $status=''; try{$status=& openclaw gateway status --json 2>&1 | Out-String}catch{}; $status | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'gateway-before-050.json') -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output 'V41_050_BACKUP=PASS'
script: & openclaw config set gateway.mode local 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_MODE_CONFIG_FAILED'}; & openclaw gateway install 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_INSTALL_FAILED'}; & openclaw gateway restart 2>&1 | Out-Null; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_RESTART_FAILED'}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $s=& openclaw gateway status --json 2>&1 | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_STATUS_FAILED'}; $s | Set-Content -LiteralPath 'C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge/gateway-after-050.json' -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output 'V41_050_GATEWAY=PASS'
test: $raw=& openclaw gateway status --json 2>&1 | Out-String; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GATEWAY_NOT_HEALTHY'}; try{$null=$raw | ConvertFrom-Json}catch{throw 'GATEWAY_JSON_INVALID'}; $task=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'OpenClaw Gateway' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($null -eq $task){ $startup=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup'; if(-not(Get-ChildItem $startup -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -match 'OpenClaw'})){throw 'GATEWAY_AUTOSTART_NOT_FOUND'} }; Write-Output 'V41_050_TEST=PASS'
rollback: try{& openclaw gateway stop 2>$null | Out-Null}catch{}; try{& openclaw gateway uninstall 2>$null | Out-Null}catch{}; Write-Output 'V41_050_ROLLBACK=PASS'
